name: Rula
short_description: Free-to-join network where licensed clinicians see insured clients as 1099 contractors, with rates set by Rula's payer contracts.
long_description: Rula (formerly Path Mental Health) contracts licensed clinicians to see insured clients through its platform. Joining is free, with no minimum hours. Rula says most therapists are credentialed and see a first client within about three weeks. Pay rates come from Rula's payer contracts and are paid biweekly. Sessions run on Rula's Zoom account, notes are due within 48 hours, and clinicians work as 1099 contractors. Therapy and psychiatric (PMHNP, MD/DO) tracks are available in all 50 states and DC.
one_liner: Insured clients with no membership fee, on Rula's platform and terms.
best_for: Licensed clinicians who want insured clients with no membership fee
Clinicians who want to start quickly (Rula says about three weeks to a first client)
Filling part of a caseload with no minimum hours
not_for: Clinicians who want to set their own rates or use their own EHR and telehealth (Rula's Zoom is required)
Clinicians who dislike strict documentation deadlines (48-hour notes, with pay reductions)
Clinicians building an independent practice brand

notes.insurance-billing: Free to join; Rula holds the payer contracts and pays biweekly, so you see insured clients without billing.
notes.low-volume: No minimum hours, so it can fill part of a caseload alongside a private practice.

pricing.notes: No membership fee. Rula sets pay rates from its payer contracts; clinicians are 1099 contractors paid biweekly.

seo.title: Rula: Flat Per-Session Pay for Therapists & Psychiatrists
seo.meta_description: Rula (formerly Path Mental Health) offers flat $70-90/session rates for therapists and e-prescribing for psychiatrists. Weekly payments, all 50 states.

faqs.q: How much does Rula pay therapists?
faqs.a: Rula pays flat per-session rates ranging from $70-90 depending on your state and credentials. Unlike revenue-sharing platforms, you know exactly what you'll earn. However, rate increases have been halted since 2024.

Yes, Rula has integrated e-prescribing for psychiatric prescribers (psychiatrists, PMHNPs), including controlled substances where state law permits. This is a key differentiator from therapy-only platforms.

faqs.q: How does Rula compare to Headway or Grow Therapy?
faqs.a: Rula pays flat per-session rates ($70-90) while Headway and Grow use revenue sharing. With flat rates, you know exactly what you'll earn but don't benefit if insurers pay more. Rula uniquely supports prescribers with e-prescribing. All require giving up credential portability.

faqs.q: What happens if I leave Rula?
faqs.a: Your insurance credentials stay with Rula. You'd need to re-credential independently (60-120 days). This is the same credential lock-in as Headway, Grow, and Alma.
Yes, there are no membership fees. Rula pays you flat rates per session and handles all billing. The tradeoff is you don't control contract negotiations and rates have been frozen since 2024.
